reference: Polymetallic massive sulfide, Potter Mine (Commons title)

description.lithology: fine-grained grey-green mafic metavolcanic rock of basaltic composition with mottled to streaky texture and weak to moderate subvertical foliation/banding
description.alteration: moderate to strong chloritic alteration throughout with weak localized oxidation giving rusty spots and thin pale veinlets

anomalies.explanation: Prominent dark diagonal band with adjacent thin pale-yellow veinlet in the centre crosscuts the foliation and should be checked as a vein or lithological contact.
